methodology.series: Full UTC calendar days present in all four DeFiLlama feeds. Current UTC day excluded.
methodology.signer: Twenty-five fixed 1,000-parent-transaction-block windows spaced one million block heights apart; three windows spaced 12 million heights apart are fully hydrated. Ranges were chosen before method classification, but are not random. Count deduplicated receipts whose receiver is v1.signer and method is sign. These receipts may execute after the parent transaction window. Excludes respond, verify, and cleanup. Windows are samples, not all-network totals or proof of outbound settlement.
